inputs.label: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Morrowind, for example from Steam or GOG: the folder that contains Data Files. Tribunal and Bloodmoon are found automatically.

steps.why: The guide grants it ahead of time so the app can read /sdcard/Morrowind/.

steps.text: Open OpenMW VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for storage access, allow it.

notes: The APK file name says com.openmw.vr but the package is org.openmw.vr; the payload already has org.openmw.vr, so no packageName override is needed. Follows the guide's Option A (whole folder to /sdcard/Morrowind/); Option B pushes the Data Files contents to Android/data/org.openmw.vr/files/data/. Morrowind.esm in detect is the base game master file; the guide only says the folder contains Data Files. GOG install folder name unknown.
